brief: Before the heat event, inspect and repair the fan contactor chattering under load and the cooling stage cycling intermittently, and repair the active seepage at the lower gasket face, as work in categories 1 to 3 is to be completed before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows [SOP-016]. Also complete the deferred bushing inspection still outstanding at this visit [SOP-016]. Because this unit has degraded cooling, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023], and reduce to the ONAN rating since one full stage is unavailable on a two-stage installation [MG-021].
